annotations.title: Get one auction lot, with buyer fees and terms

description: Full public details of one auction lot by lot_id (from search_auction_lots): prices (guide, starting, current, next minimum bid), bid count, timing, the BUYER FEES and deposit the winning bidder pays on top of the price (always tell the user these), the exchange/completion timetable, the property, and the lot page and bidder-registration urls. A lot that is no longer open or scheduled for bidding shows its street and postcode district only (no house number, no full postcode), with no bid figures and no reserve-met flag. Any personal-interest disclosure and the listing text are under "untrusted_user_content". Returns an error when the lot is not public or auctions are not currently open.
name: get_auction_lot
